data.narrative:
Zephyr Fusion is a pre-seed nuclear energy company founded by two plasma physics researchers with 15+ and 20+ years of experience respectively, including tenures at Lawrence Livermore National Lab and Oak Ridge National Lab. The company has raised $500K to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe comprises 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 5 private peers (Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, Deep Atomic).

Only one valuation method is applicable to this analysis. The Stage-Progression method, which applies a 2.5x multiplier to pre-seed capital raised as a proxy for post-investment value, yields a result of $1.25M. This accounts for the typical step-up from pre-seed to seed stage. Peer-median comparison is inapplicable due to insufficient comparable data points at the same stage and valuation tier within nuclear energy; while four same-sector peers exist, none qualify as narrow comparables under stage or tier filters.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.06M–$1.44M, with a median of $1.25M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single method. Key uncertainties include the limited peer set for cross-validation and the absence of financial metrics, technology milestones, or market size data to anchor relative valuation. A more robust conclusion would require additional pre-seed nuclear energy comps or quantified technical progress markers.
